name: facebakery_facing_normal
describe: Model-bake facing+reorder: getFacingFromVertexData computes the quad normal from int[28] (Vector3f sub/cross, sqrt-normalize) and argmaxes 6 axis dots -> EnumFacing; applyFacing reorders the 4 vertices to the target facing's corner layout (min/max bounds + EnumFaceDirection vertex info) and copies u/v lanes on an epsilonEquals position match. Inputs are structured axis-aligned planar quads so the facing argmax is unambiguous. Vector3f inlined with exact LWJGL 2.9.2 semantics (validated vs the real jar).
